mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or the correlation between CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or the correlation between RSAFS declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals a strengthening supply side, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive supply signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, the combined effect signals a tightening monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, the combined effect signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also decline over the past 3 months, the combined effect signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and RSAFS decline
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During an economic expansion, a significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in the past quarter signals a strengthening supply side, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances during economic expansions despite the positive supply signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during expansions.
